resources.string: Enter an XP decoder packet body in hexadecimal, without the E3 prefix added by FYT. This does not translate Honda service packets or CAN IDs. No automatic retry or vehicle confirmation is available. After dispatch, reconnect to obtain new vehicle feedback.
Enter 1–64 bytes, each with two hexadecimal digits, separated by spaces.
Connection or parked acknowledgement changed. Open the action again.

Profile: XP 0x4012A
FYT command: 1008
Packet body: %1$s

This sends exactly the entered bytes to FYT. The vehicle result will remain unconfirmed. The app disconnects afterward; reconnect for new live readings.
Dispatching XP packet — vehicle result unconfirmed.
XP packet requested (command 1008): %1$s. Not vehicle confirmation.
Packet dispatched to FYT; vehicle result unconfirmed. Disconnected — reconnect for live feedback.
XP packet dispatch failed; vehicle result unconfirmed: %1$s
XP packet dispatch timed out; vehicle result unconfirmed. No automatic retry.
